item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J02085","case1_error":"Evaluates the correctly written calorie sum as 2175 instead of 1975.","case2_error":"Evaluates 15 × 0.40 as 30 instead of 6.","reason":"Both numerically miscalculate a correctly written expression, then propagate that result.","judgment":"same"},{"pair_id":"J02086","case1_error":"Reports 5 inches per original segment; whether the question requests segments or joined ropes is ambiguous.","case2_error":"Treats 675/150, the number of eight-minute batches, as elapsed minutes, omitting multiplication by 8.","reason":"The rope question ambiguously refers to “pieces,” so its segment-length answer is not clearly erroneous. The machine solution clearly confuses batches with minutes.","judgment":"uncertain"},{"pair_id":"J02087","case1_error":"Uses three aunts instead of four and substitutes Iris for the listed brother.","case2_error":"Leading answer marker says 14, but the derivation correctly gives the combined size as 21.","reason":"Case 2 contains only an answer-marker conflict, preventing a comparison of two clear mathematical error mechanisms.","judgment":"uncertain"},{"pair_id":"J02088","case1_error":"Applies the 20% car-payment proportion to gross income instead of after-tax income.","case2_error":"Treats monthly material costs as per-vehicle costs, multiplying each total cost by production quantity.","reason":"Case 1 uses the wrong income base for a percentage; case 2 converts aggregate costs into unit costs and repeatedly charges them.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02089","case1_error":"Counts the two parent lambs again even though they are already included in the original six.","case2_error":"Assigns all 60 remaining cupcakes to each flavor instead of splitting the remainder between them.","reason":"Case 1 double-counts an existing subset; case 2 duplicates a total across categories instead of partitioning it.","judgment":"different"}]}
